aiSummary.oneLiner: A simplified economic modeling framework for educational simulations.
aiSummary.whatItDoes: This repository offers a foundational framework for building simple economic models and simulations. It provides basic modules for simulating supply, demand, and market equilibrium. The project is designed to be highly accessible for students learning basic economic principles through code. It includes example simulations demonstrating the effects of taxes and subsidies on a market. The framework focuses on clarity and simplicity over complex macroeconomic accuracy. It allows users to visualize market shifts through basic terminal outputs or simple plotted graphs.
keyFeatures: Market simulation: Models basic interactions between supply and demand curves.
Policy effects: Simulates the impact of interventions like taxes, price floors, and subsidies.
Educational focus: Designed with clear, readable code to teach economic concepts.
Equilibrium calculation: Automatically determines market clearing prices and quantities.
Basic visualization: Provides simple text-based or basic graphical outputs of market states.

useCases.title: Economics learning

aiSummary.whoIsItFor: This framework is intended for economics educators and students looking for practical coding applications. It is suitable for beginners in Python who want to apply programming to economic theory. Hobbyists interested in simple market simulations will find it accessible.
